# Credits

<!-- Generated by scripts/credits/generate.mjs. Do not edit: run `pnpm credits`. -->

octopus-diff is built on open-source software. This file lists every third-party package it
depends on, the programs it runs, the code adapted from other projects and the projects whose
ideas shaped it. The app shows the same list, with each license text, in **Settings → About**.
octopus-diff itself is MIT licensed (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)).

This file is generated from the `package.json` files, the installed packages and
[`scripts/credits/acknowledgements.json`](scripts/credits/acknowledgements.json). After any
dependency change run `pnpm credits` and commit the result; `pnpm lint` fails until you do. Code
adapted from another project goes into `acknowledgements.json` (see
[AGENTS.md § Dependencies](AGENTS.md#dependencies)).

- `@parcel/watcher`: Also installs a prebuilt native binary for your platform (@parcel/watcher-<platform>, MIT).
- `electron`: The desktop app is the Electron binary with octopus-diff's code in an asar archive, so Electron's runtime ships with it, including Chromium (BSD-3-Clause, plus the licenses of its third-party components) and Node.js (MIT). Their full license texts are installed next to the app's executable: LICENSES.chromium.html and LICENSE.electron.txt. (Electron's npm dependencies only download the binary and do not ship.)
- `tailwindcss`: A build tool, but the CSS it generates (including its preflight reset) is part of the web UI.

## Programs octopus-diff runs

- **[Git](https://git-scm.com/)** (GPL-2.0-only). The daemon runs your installed git as a separate program for every read. octopus-diff does not bundle or link it.
- **[GitHub CLI (gh)](https://cli.github.com/)** (MIT). Optional. When installed and signed in, the daemon runs it for read-only pull request queries (docs/FORGES.md). octopus-diff does not bundle it and never reads its token.
- **[GitLab CLI (glab)](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli)** (MIT). Optional. When installed and signed in, the daemon runs it for read-only merge request queries (docs/FORGES.md). octopus-diff does not bundle it and never reads its token.

## Code adapted from other projects

Each adapted file also carries an attribution comment.

- **[T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code)**, MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 T3 Tools Inc.
  - `apps/web/src/components/diff/DiffWorkerPool.tsx`: Adapted from apps/web/src/components/DiffWorkerPoolProvider.tsx.
  - `apps/web/src/lib/folderPath.ts`: The path rules of the command-palette browse mode.
  - `apps/web/test/folderPath.test.ts`: Test cases ported from packages/shared/src/path.test.ts.
  - `packages/forge/src/auth.ts`: The auth-status host parser, adapted from packages/source-control-gitlab/src/server/gitLabAuthStatus.ts.
  - `packages/forge/src/details.ts`: The check-status mapping and the "unfinished runs outrank finished ones" dedupe, adapted from toCheckStatus / toCheckEntries in packages/source-control-github/src/server/gitHubPullRequestJson.ts.
  - `apps/web/src/lib/request.ts`: Checks grouping and the status-line wording, adapted from groupPullRequestChecks / describePullRequestChecks in apps/web/src/components/pullRequest/pullRequestDetail.logic.ts.
  - `apps/web/src/lib/markdown.ts`: visibleBody (HTML comments stripped before rendering), from apps/web/src/components/pullRequest/pullRequestDetail.logic.ts.
  - `apps/web/src/lib/copy.ts`: The hidden-textarea clipboard fallback, adapted from writeTextWithExecCommand / writeTextToClipboard in apps/web/src/hooks/useCopyToClipboard.ts.
  - `apps/web/src/lib/copyFormat.ts`: Diff lines of a selected range and the fence language by extension, adapted from buildDiffReviewLines / inferReviewCommentFenceLanguage / formatReviewCommentFence in apps/web/src/reviewCommentContext.ts.
  - `apps/web/src/components/CopyButton.tsx`: Copy feedback (copied state, check icon, anchored "Copied!" toast), modelled on useCopyToClipboard, DiffFilePathCopyButton and anchoredCopyToast.
  - `apps/web/src/lib/selectionPosition.ts`: Placement of the floating Copy bar next to the pointer, after resolveSelectionActionPosition in apps/web/src/lib/selectionActions.ts.
  - The sidebar (folders, the Settled shelf, settling by hand), the folder picker and the command palette's browse mode are modelled on T3 Code's UI. The forge integration (remote recognition, CLI-login refinement for self-hosted hosts, the GitHub base-repository order, the merge request fields and PR glyphs) follows T3 Code's source-control packages.

gitpane, difit, SproutGit, overgit, Archipel, DiffDino, Emdash, Paradev, Vibe Kanban, which explored multi-repository, worktree and agent-review views
before us (see `docs/PLAN.md` §3).
